# CodingCush Games

> Free games that run in the web browser, made with the Godot 4 engine by CodingCush (codingcush.com). No download and no real-money purchases. A free account saves progress online and posts scores to a global leaderboard.

## Games

- [Vyomastra](https://games.codingcush.com/vyomastra/): free vertical space shooter. Five weapons (Blaster, Rapid, Heavy, Wide, Pierce), boss fights, three ships (Arrow, Bulwark, Wisp), paint colours, coins and diamonds, global leaderboard. Plays with touch, mouse, keyboard or gamepad. Seven levels are playable (Low Orbit, Rock Belt, Ice Moon, Storm Giant, The Hive, Scrap Sea and Armada) and eight are planned. In Rock Belt, large asteroids cannot be destroyed and must be dodged. In Ice Moon, frost shots freeze the ship (slower movement and firing) instead of costing a life; a second freeze while frozen costs a life. In Storm Giant, gusts of wind push the ship sideways and lightning strikes a column of the screen about a second after a flickering warning line appears. In The Hive, captured pilots drift down wrapped in green webs: shooting or touching the web frees them for score and coins, and every third rescue drops an extra life. In Scrap Sea, a cargo ship flies ahead of the player: raiders line up above it and dive, scrap dents it and snipers fire yellow shots at it; if its hull reaches zero the mission is lost, and the hull slowly repairs itself when left alone. In Armada, every enemy that leaves the bottom of the screen alive weakens a defence line of 12 points (a frigate costs 3); at zero the mission is lost. Two computer-flown wingmen fly beside the player and fire with them.

## Facts

- Price: free. Coins and diamonds are earned only by playing.
- Platform: current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a phone, tablet, laptop or desktop computer.
- Controls (Vyomastra): on touch screens drag to move (fires automatically); with a mouse the ship follows the cursor and the left button fires; arrow keys or WASD to move, Space or J to fire, Esc or P to pause; gamepad supported.
- Accounts: optional; email and password, or Google or Facebook sign-in, inside each game under Account. Accounts can be deleted there too.
- Privacy policy: https://games.codingcush.com/privacy/
- Publisher: CodingCush, https://codingcush.com/
